title: null is an answer, not a failure — the model is told to use the pages, not what it knows
summary: The answer call is told to use ONLY the passages it is given and to answer null (or say the sources do not say) when they do not contain the answer. Measured: asked for Python's default recursion limit starting from the sys module's documentation page, the job read 2 pages and answered 'The sources do not say.' — correct, because that page never states the number (its only '1000's are sys.tracebacklimit's default and a Windows resource id), even though every model knows it. A null answer completes normally, is never a schema violation, and resubmitting the identical request within 24 hours returns the same job. Report it as 'the pages read do not say', name the pages, and change what is read (a better start page, seed instead of single) rather than retrying.
